messages:
Sophie: Heads-up: CI auth migration next week. Moving off long-lived org PATs to an OIDC-backed identity-proxy + GH Enterprise App. Cutover window: Tue 2026-04-06 02:00-04:00 UTC. Read and flag blockers.

Ajay: Why proxy vs direct OIDC?

Sophie: Central token minting, supports legacy jobs, enables ephemeral creds for self-hosted runners.

Mara: Security win: kill long-lived PATs, rotate service keys during cutover.

dan (devex): Will reusable workflow templates break? Many reference org PATs.

Sophie: Templates must switch to the helper action. We'll publish migration helpers and examples.

BuildBot: infra/proxy@main deploy-check green :white_check_mark:

jules: Paste example step?

Sophie: Use this helper:
- name: Acquire CI token
  uses: redwood/infrabox/get-ci-token@v1
  with:
    audience: gist-read
This exchanges OIDC assertion via proxy and sets ephemeral token in GITHUB_ENV.

tom: Runner re-registration needed? We have pools in us-west+eu.

Ajay: No full re-register required; add PROXY_URL to runner env and restart. We'll push a helper docker image for refresh.

riley: Rollback plan?

Sophie: 1) Flip proxy to pass-through (30s). 2) Re-enable org PATs for 1h emergency. 3) Revert templates. Monitor closely.

Mara: If auth-fail rate >5% for 15m, escalate to incident channel. We'll track token issuance and latency.

katie: I'll publish Confluence migration doc + checklist and a champions sync.

dan (devex): Timeline:
- Fri 2026-04-02: docs + helpers
- Mon 2026-04-05: 5% canary
- Tue 2026-04-06 02:00-04:00 UTC: full cutover

Sophie: Opt-in canary via action flag `canary: true` and we'll onboard repo list.

tom: Third-party connectors?

Sophie: Must use OIDC via GH App or proxy-minted short-lived tokens. We'll contact partners.

riley: Can we auto-notify repos on auth-fail?

Mara: Yes — issues-bot will file repo-level issues during canary.

jules: Local dev (act) impact?

Ajay: Local runs need short-lived token; we'll ship `scripts/dev-get-token.sh`.

BuildBot: canary-runner-01 job 4023 failed with `401 token` at 1930123590 ">

Ajay: Investigating logs; found a post step using org PAT. PR incoming to use proxy action.

Sophie: Final reminder 24h before cutover. Compliance deadline to remove PATs is Apr 30 — this meets that requirement. DM me repo names to join canary.

jules: DM sent. Will test and report.
